clients.notes: Two parallel engagements: reporting dashboard and design system.
Booking portal in review; accessibility audit delivered in June.
Storefront rebuild ahead of the spring catalogue.
Shipment tracker delivered in August. Support retainer ended.
Ordering app paused while the client finalises its supplier change.

projects.name: Northwind Reporting Dashboard
projects.description: A reporting dashboard that replaces weekly spreadsheet exports with live portfolio metrics.

projects.name: Harbor Patient Booking Portal
projects.description: Online appointment booking across four clinics, with reminders and rescheduling.

projects.name: Kettle & Co. Storefront Rebuild
projects.description: A faster storefront with a rebuilt product catalogue and a two-step checkout.

projects.name: Lumen Course Catalogue
projects.description: A searchable public catalogue for 120 short courses, with filters by level and format.

projects.name: Atlas Shipment Tracker
projects.description: A customer-facing tracker for freight shipments with live status and delivery windows.

projects.name: Verdant Listings Website
projects.description: A listings website with neighbourhood guides and a self-serve content workflow.

projects.name: Northwind Design System
projects.description: Tokens, components and documentation shared by Northwind's three product teams.

projects.name: Fieldnote Ordering App UX
projects.description: Research and prototypes for a pre-order app used by cafés and wholesale buyers.

projects.name: Harbor Accessibility Audit
projects.description: A WCAG 2.2 AA audit of the existing patient site, with a prioritised fix list.

projects.name: Kettle & Co. Loyalty Program
projects.description: A points-based loyalty programme integrated with the new storefront accounts.
